ACTION_PLANS.description: Shared Core multi-step Action Plans, Antigravity-style Implementation Plans, interactive revision, and execution checkpoints.

commands.complete_plan: Finalize the active Action Plan once ALL steps have been executed and verified.
commands.create_plan: Create a structured Antigravity-style Implementation Plan & executable step checklist.
commands.get_plan: Return current step checklist and progress of the active Action Plan.
commands.revise_plan: Revise the active Implementation Plan in-place according to user feedback without editing code files yet.

commands.get_backend_status: Verifies if the AI backend (Ollama, Kobold, or Cloud) is online and ready.
commands.get_full_dashboard: Returns a complete report of all hardware resources and AI backend status.
commands.get_gpu_status: Returns the video card (GPU) status, including VRAM usage and thermal/computational load.
commands.get_system_resources: Returns a summary of system CPU and RAM usage.

EXECUTOR.description: Safe Python execution (AST Sandbox), developer tools, system control, and file management.

commands.check_syntax: Checks syntax of a Python (.py), JSON (.json), YAML (.yaml/.yml), or JS (.js) file on disk.
commands.create_dir: Creates a directory and any missing parent folders.
commands.execute_shell_command: Executes a shell command with python_env tools (pytest, ruff, uv, python) on PATH.
commands.execute_slash_command: Executes an HDCS direct slash command (e.g. /img, /automation.click).
commands.get_app_logs: Reads live status and log output of a managed workspace application.
commands.get_important_paths: Returns all the important paths memorized by the user, plus the default sandbox workspace.
commands.git_checkpoint: Saves a non-destructive Git checkpoint snapshot (tracked + untracked files) without mutating HEAD.
commands.git_diff: Shows unified Git diff (size-capped) for the repository or a specific file.
commands.git_restore: Restores a file (or the full tree when confirm_all=True) from HEAD or a saved checkpoint ('latest' or SHA).
commands.git_status: Inspects Git branch and modified/untracked files inside a project repository.
commands.list_running_apps: Lists all active and recent workspace runs, including orphaned OS processes.
commands.move_path: Moves or renames a file or folder inside the authorized workspace.
commands.open_coding_cli: Opens a native Windows coding CLI window for a workspace project:
commands.open_media_file: Opens a media file (video, audio, image) using VLC if installed, otherwise the OS default player.
commands.patch_file: Replaces a unique existing occurrence of old_text with new_text in a file.
commands.probe_url: Tests a local running web server URL (http://127.0.0.1:<port> or http://localhost:<port>),
commands.project_tree: Generates a compact project folder tree (skipping .git, __pycache__, python_env, node_modules).
commands.read_file: Reads the contents of a file. Relative paths resolve inside the projects workspace.
commands.repo_map: Generates a compact multi-language AST map (files, classes, functions, line numbers) for a codebase.
commands.run_aider_task: Delegates a multi-file refactor/generation task to isolated Aider CLI (if installed).
commands.run_project_test: Runs a real Python script, unittest, or pytest suite inside an authorized workspace/project using python_env.
commands.search_code: Searches text/code recursively inside a project or module directory.
commands.set_important_path: Memorizes an important directory path for the user (e.g. user_profile, downloads, projects).
commands.start_app: Starts a persistent workspace script, local web server (Flask/FastAPI/Streamlit), or desktop GUI app
commands.stop_app: Stops a running workspace application by run_id, OS PID (e.g. '38300' or 'os_38300'),
commands.stop_project_processes: Stops all managed and orphaned OS processes locking a workspace project or file.
commands.write_file: Writes or creates a file and verifies it exists on disk. Relative paths resolve inside the projects workspace.

HELP.description: Displays the list of all active commands and modules in the system.

commands.list_capabilities: Displays the complete list of all tools, modules, and capabilities currently loaded in the system.
commands.refresh_registry: Forces a re-read and update of the central capabilities registry (rescans plugins).

MEMORY.description: Access to the Vault of memories and Admin profile (Identity and History).

commands.rag_ingest_file: Ingest a local file into the vector knowledge base.
commands.rag_search: Perform a semantic search in the long-term vector memory (RAG).
commands.rag_store: Store a piece of information permanently in the vector knowledge base.
commands.read_history: Extract the last N saved messages from the database history.
commands.remember_info: Save important information about the user in the biographical profile.
commands.reset_memory: Execute the Tabula Rasa protocol: clear the entire episodic chat history.
commands.who_am_i: Ask Hecos to retrieve identity data for the Admin and the AI (context profile).

MODELS.description: Changes the AI model based on the active backend (Ollama/Kobold).

commands.get_current_backend: Returns the AI backend currently in use (e.g., cloud, ollama, kobold).
commands.list_models: Lists all available models for the currently selected backend.
commands.set_model: Sets a new active AI model based on the numeric index obtained from list_models.

PERSONALITY.description: Manage and switch AI personalities (souls) dynamically.

commands.list_souls: Elenca tutte le personalità (souls) attualmente disponibili nel sistema.
commands.switch_soul: Cambia la personalità attiva. Accetta sia il nome esatto (es. "Motoko") sia l'indice numerico.

WEB_UI.description: Native Web Interface — Chat + Config Panel on localhost:7070

commands.get_panel_url: Returns the URL of the chat interface.
commands.open_browser: Opens the Hecos web interface in the default browser if not already open.

AUTOMATION.description: PC Automation: control the mouse, keyboard, and application windows. Use with desktop_screenshot for a full see-and-act loop.

commands.click: Clicks the mouse at the given screen coordinates.
commands.click_text: Locates text on the screen via OCR and clicks it.
commands.drag: Clicks and drags from one position to another.
commands.focus_browser_tab: Clicks on a browser tab whose title contains the given text fragment (case-insensitive).
commands.focus_window: Brings a window to the foreground by partial title match.
commands.get_browser_tabs: Returns the titles of all currently open tabs in Chrome, Edge, Opera, or Brave.
commands.get_mouse_position: Returns the current mouse cursor coordinates (x, y).
commands.get_screen_size: Returns the screen resolution (width x height in pixels).
commands.hotkey: Executes a keyboard shortcut by holding multiple keys simultaneously.
commands.list_windows: Returns a list of all currently visible window titles.
commands.maximize_window: Maximizes a window by partial title match.
commands.minimize_window: Minimizes a window by partial title match.
commands.move_to: Moves the mouse cursor to the specified screen coordinates.
commands.press_key: Presses and releases a single key.
commands.read_window_controls: Reads the UI control tree (buttons, inputs, links) of an application window.
commands.scroll: Scrolls the mouse wheel at the specified position.
commands.type_and_enter: Types the given text and immediately presses Enter.
commands.type_text: Types the given text as simulated keystrokes.

AUTOMATION.routing_instructions: VISION/AUTOMATION SYNERGY: You DO have 'eyes'! You can interact with the user's screen. When asked to click on something or read the screen, FIRST call WEBCAM__desktop_screenshot. The system will return the image to your context. THEN analyze the image to find the exact (x, y) coordinates. FINALLY, call AUTOMATION__move_to or AUTOMATION__click with those coordinates.
